reviews.title: REFUND
reviews.text:
Very disappointed. I signed up for a 7-day free trial, only to be charged RM35 immediately. Calling something a “free trial” while taking payment right away feels misleading and unfair to users.

I would not have subscribed if I had known I would be charged instantly. Transparency is important, and users deserve clear information before any payment is processed. This experience has completely ruined my first impression of the app.

I strongly encourage the developers to review their subscription system and provide refunds to users who were unexpectedly charged.
